column1: # The function may (the right contract, «The function may»): may(grants, as_of, disabled, user, glass, cap, unit, now) → allow | deny <word>.
# input — the input of the command may as JSON text: grants — {lines} the grant rows (a trusted input) or null; as_of — the receipt of the copy (null — the holder's row);
# unit — null, "*" or {sub, id, labels, about?}; now — the checker's wall seconds. expect — a subset of the output or «@exit 2» (the input is out of form).
# The rows — the acceptance inputs of M11/9 inputs/may-*.json, sc. 07 (removed by the move of lesson 8; may-24 — with labels: [], README).
# A row: case<TAB>input<TAB>expect<TAB>note. The rows may-27…may-106 — ADR-0097–ADR-0100: the input carries sub, roles, unread, iat and chains; they have no dry run by an implementation.
